latestVersion.changelog:
Editor Freelance — First release:

- Instantly edit and process client videos with AI-assisted cloud rendering; no pro editing software needed.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; describe edits and get polished clips in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated token/session setup with anonymous-mode for new users; 100 free credits with 7-day tokens.
- Simple commands for uploading, editing, checking credits/status, and exporting 1080p MP4.
- Session-based workflow supports batch processing, iterative edits, and quick previews.
- Built-in error handling for tokens, file size, unsupported formats, plan limits, and rate limits.
